description: codex-review calibration corpus — small diffs with KNOWN verdicts, for measuring the reviewer's recall and precision on demand. Each fixture is materialized into a throwaway git repo (base/ committed, change/ overlaid as the working-tree diff) and reviewed via the normal two-phase runner. See references/calibration.md.

fixtures.description: shipping-rate thresholds changed from >= to > — off-by-one boundary regressions (total exactly 100 and exactly 50 now take the wrong bracket)

defects.note: a real finding must engage with the exact boundary value 100
and with 50; 100 alone is not enough
the >= -> > shift is a boundary/off-by-one class defect

fixtures.description: renderCart switched from i.price (always present) to i.discountPrice (nullable from the backend) with no guard — null.toFixed throws at runtime

defects.note: the unhandled null/undefined is the defect (rubric item 1)
must name the field the change introduced

fixtures.description: fetchOrders now catches every failure and returns [] — callers cannot distinguish an empty order list from a backend failure; error context lost

defects.note: the [] return conflates failure with an empty result

fixtures.description: new vip branch ships with a test that asserts only typeof boolean — it passes equally well against the pre-change code (rubric item 6); the branch itself is fine

defects.note: must engage with 'passes equally well against the pre-change code'
or name the tautology class directly
or point at the assertion that proves nothing

fixtures.description: search() dropped its request-generation guard — when an older query resolves after a newer one, its results overwrite the newer results, and the first completion clears loading while the newer request is still in flight

defects.note: out-of-order completion: an older response overwrites the newer query's results
an earlier completion sets loading=false while a newer request is still pending

fixtures.description: the generation guard in search() is extracted into an isCurrent() closure — identical behaviour, guard kept on all three paths (clean twin of stale-response)
summarize() is refactored with identical output; the same file still holds the unguarded search() race from stale-response, which the patch does not touch and must not be reported
netPrice extracted taxAmount into a helper — arithmetic identical, no behavior change
additive farewell() with a real failing-capable test; greet() untouched
